firstImpression: 左上黑绿两行硬切巨字先喊出把城市做成游戏，右侧真人用双手展示，下方低模巴黎与前景小车立即兑现承诺
primaryMechanism: 左上两行超重硬切巨字提出动作与结果，右侧真人双手把视线导向左下可识别的低多边形成果世界，底部接地的交互物兑现可玩性；三者以同一主题和透视构成因果关系
dominantAxis: 左上水平双行字块与右侧人脸对衡；手臂形成右上至左下的展示斜线，最终落到塔和汽车

zones.align: full width visible behind title, face and hands
two open hands direct attention to lower left
left midground, spire enters white zone

layerOrderBackToFront: identity line and two title layers
imageTextRelationship: 字面结果由城市低模画面兑现；真人手势把视线从创作者送到作品，不让人物与场景成为无关拼贴

typography.identityLine: upright extra-bold sans, black, moderately tight tracking, one line
typography.mainTitle: near-square extra-heavy Han skeleton, dense small counters, individual angular cuts and limited per-glyph rotation; no stroke, shadow, glow or extrusion
typography.lowerRole: deep saturated result, same glyph family

colorRoles.primaryText: near-black upper line, around 8-11% visible area
colorRoles.secondaryTitle: deep color lower line, around 7-10% visible area
colorRoles.personSupport: light clothing and natural skin, around 18-23% visible area
colorRoles.scene: cool/warm separated low-poly world, around 27-33% visible area
colorRoles.accent: small warm landmark and front object, subordinate to title
colorRoles.contrast: main title must remain sharply separated from white background; lower color cannot merge with scene green

failureModes: face or hands covered by title
photo-real city mixed with low-poly tower
